mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT ON (a.id) COALESCE(c.id, b.id, -a.id) AS id, a.id AS role_id, #{resourceType} AS resource_type, #{action} AS action, COALESCE(c.scope_type, b.scope_type, a.default_data_scope) AS scope_type FROM t_sys_role a INNER JOIN t_sys_user_role d ON d.role_id = a.id LEFT JOIN t_sys_role_data_scope b ON b.role_id = a.id AND b.resource_type = #{resourceType} AND b.action IS NULL LEFT JOIN t_sys_role_data_scope c ON c.role_id = a.id AND c.resource_type = #{resourceType} AND c.action = #{action} WHERE d.user_id = #{userId} AND d.org_id = #{orgId} ORDER BY a.id
